name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.160: The download mark names files, and an unlabelled sidecar gets its name.
    A regular subtitle and its hearing-impaired variant are two files on disk, but the
    mark recorded both as the plain language - so a successful regular save closed the
    variant's slot too, the mark claimed a file that was not there, and the refresh
    contradicted it on every pass. Measured on the live library: 31 items re-searched in
    one morning, 16 regular sidecars rewritten although they were already on disk. The
    mark now carries one token per required file (DE, DE:hi), which ends the loop; no
    expiry and no give-up, a variant SubDL does not carry today is looked for again on
    the next refetch.
    A subtitle file whose NAME carries no language proved no coverage at all: it was
    skipped, never recorded, and its item was searched for a language its own disk
    already held. The scan now detects such a file's language from its text and renames
    it to the shape this plugin writes, <container>.<lang>.srt - behind the existing
    resolve-und switch, with the same 2 KB floor and the same skip when nothing is found.
    A file that already names its language is never touched, and a taken name takes the
    next free slot instead of overwriting a subtitle. Two defects found on the way are
    fixed with it: a rename would have destroyed the stored row (the refresh forgets a
    sidecar whose path is gone), and an observation without a language was rewritten on
    every pass forever.
